name: Liturgy II
text: At the end of a tactical action in this unit's system, you may place or move 1 nexus token into a non-home system that contains 1 or more of your ships and no other player's ships.

name: Non-Euclidean Geometries
text: During your tactical actions, apply +1 to the move value of any ship that starts its movement in a system that contains 1 or more of your nexus tokens. You may treat nebulas as adjacent to each other for the purposes of movement.

name: Resonance Drive
text: During movement, you may exhaust this card and destroy 1 of your non-fighter ships on the board to apply +1 to the move value of a number of ships equal to the cost of the destroyed ship until the end of this tactical action.

name: Atomization
text: At the start of your turn, you may exhaust this card and destroy 1 of your non-fighter ships with a cost of up to 3 to capture a number of fighters from the supply equal to the cost of the destroyed ship.

name: Cinderborn II
text: DEPLOY: At the start of a round of ground combat on a planet you control, you may place 1 captured infantry from your faction sheet on that planet.

name: Ashfall Engine II
text: This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards. During combat, when this unit would be destroyed or uses its SUSTAIN DAMAGE ability, you may use its BOMBARDMENT ability against a planet in its system.

name: Tideyard II
text: DEPLOY: At the end of a tactical action, you may remove 2 of your mechs from the active system to place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control in the active system. Up to 8 fighters in that system do not count against your ships' capacity. PRODUCTION 7.

name: Modular Fleet
text: At the start of your turn, you may choose 1 of your non-fighter ships in a system that contains 1 or more of your units with PRODUCTION. Spend resources equal to the difference between that ship’s cost and the cost of another non-fighter ship in your reinforcements with a higher cost than the chosen ship to replace the chosen ship with that ship.

name: Quantum Restructuring
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to choose a planet you control that has an attachment. Place 1 pds from your reinforcements on that planet.

name: Resource Optimization
text: At the end of your turn, you may exhaust this card and 1 planet you control to ready 1 other planet you control. If that planet has an ability card, you may ready it as well.

name: Data Mining
text: When you gain a technology, for each other player that also owns that technology, gain 1 trade good.

name: Mimetic Override
text: At the start of a round of combat, you may exhaust this card and choose 1 technology owned by both you and your opponent. During this round of combat, apply +1 to the result of a number of dice up to the number of prerequisites on that technology.

name: Divine Manifestation
text: Each system that contains 1 or more of your units and an anomaly gains PRODUCTION 2 as if it were a unit you control.

name: Chaos Turbines
text: You may treat non-home systems that contain printed anomalies as adjacent to each other for the purposes of movement.

name: Völundr Protocol
text:
ACTION: Exhaust this card to ready a planet that contains one of your PDS units.

After you win a ground combat, ready this card.

name: Bilröst II
text:
You may use this unit’s SPACE CANNON against ships in adjacent systems.

During the “Commit Ground Forces” step of an invasion in this or an adjacent system, you may commit up to 1 ground force from this unit’s planet or an adjacent planet.
